metaDescription: The /instinct command reference: info, set grade, set veterancy, and reload, with permission levels.
title: Commands
lede: Everything under one root: /instinct. Output is localized; admin subcommands need permission level 2 (op).

rows: Reports on the animal you're looking at (up to 8 blocks): species, pet/livestock membership and which rule granted it, bloodline grade and perk, veterancy days and rank, downed status, trough-fed recency, pedigree-treat flag
Sets the bloodline grade of the animal you're looking at
Sets accrued veterancy days (0–100000) on the pet you're looking at; rank and bonuses re-derive immediately
Reloads config/instinct.json and reports how many keys changed
